oneLiner: An app that plans a week of meals around what's already in the fridge.
problem: People waste food and money by not knowing what to cook with ingredients they already have, leading to redundant grocery shopping and meal planning paralysis.
targetUser: Busy home cooks aged 25-45 who want to reduce food waste, save money, and simplify weekly meal planning.
coreFlow: User specifies dietary preferences and meal count for the week
App generates a customized meal plan using available ingredients
User reviews generated meals and can swap or adjust recipes
User views shopping list for any missing ingredients needed

screens.name: Inventory Input
screens.purpose: Allow users to quickly add items currently in their fridge, freezer, and pantry with expiration dates

screens.name: Preferences Setup
screens.purpose: Capture dietary restrictions, cuisine preferences, and number of meals/servings needed for the week

screens.name: Meal Plan View
screens.purpose: Display the generated 7-day meal plan with recipes, organized by day

screens.name: Recipe Details
screens.purpose: Show full recipe with ingredients highlighted (what's available vs. what to buy) and cooking instructions

screens.name: Shopping List
screens.purpose: Generate organized shopping list for missing ingredients, with options to filter by store section
